verdict.rationale: Working Copy exposes automation surfaces (Shortcuts, x-callback-url), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The automation and JavaScript-console features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
